heroTitle: AI{'@'}UI — Real UIs from any AI Agent
heroSummary: Let your backend express UI intent as JSON commands, then have the frontend runtime render real components. No backend SDK bindings, any language, any transport.
renderDescription: Spawn a UI component at a target location with initial data. No page reload.
updateDescription: Patch live component data in-place without touching anything else on screen.
destroyDescription: Remove a widget cleanly when the Agent is done. Pages stay tidy.
archFeat1Desc: Drive the protocol over WebSocket, SSE, or HTTP Polling. The Runtime doesn't care how bytes arrive.
archFeat2Desc: All your backend does is emit JSON. Python, Go, Node.js, Rust — no backend SDK package required.
archFeat3Desc: The Runtime is a thin adapter layer. Use the official adapter for your frontend stack, or add a new adapter when needed.
skillTitle: Help AI Coding integrate A{'@'}UI correctly.
skillLead: A{'@'}UI ships an installable Agent Skill so coding agents can read the frontend runtime setup, component manifest contract, command protocol, and integration constraints instead of guessing from scratch.
skillPointRuntimeDesc: Guide coding agents to install the official npm package and consume command streams through the frontend runtime.
skillPointProtocolDesc: Keep generated commands limited to render, update, and destroy instead of ad hoc fields or payloads.
skillPointManifestDesc: Remind agents to read the manifest and match registered component names, params, and lifecycle support.
skillInstallHint: After installation, AI Coding can load A{'@'}UI protocol, runtime, and manifest constraints during integration work.
showcase1Desc: A live site built with the A{'@'}UI architecture, fully demonstrating Agent-driven UI rendering.
showcase2Desc: Built an AI-driven interface with A{'@'}UI? Open an Issue or PR — your project could be featured here.
showcase3Desc: More showcases in preparation. This area will be updated once demo GIFs and screenshots are ready.
contribLead: Born from a real pain point while building AI products — written in spare time, refined ever since. No sponsors, no company. Protocol design, runtime, and docs are all maintained by me alone. Every issue and PR you open directly shapes where this goes.
contribIssueDesc: Found a bug or have an idea about the protocol or runtime? Open an issue — I read every single one.
contribPrDesc: From fixing a typo in the docs to adding a new runtime adapter — all sizes of PRs are warmly welcome.
contribStarDesc: Give the project a star to help other developers facing the same problem discover it.
contribBanner: Join GitHub Discussions for protocol design, feature planning, and technical conversations
